sbh1.3:1.9: Printed *satkāyavairāgyam*; read *samāno vairāgyam* with Wayman (Shukla p. 34 n. 1; cf. 1.12); Xuanzang 於欲界而得離欲 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:2.3: Printed text omits *indriyasaṁvara* (Wayman adds it, Shukla p. 36 n. 2; uddāna 82.1; Xuanzang 根律儀, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:2.11: Printed *avipannakāyakarmāntaś ca* twice; the second read *avipannavākkarmāntaś ca* (Xuanzang 不虧語業, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:3.2: *saptanairyāṇikaṁ śīlam*: the Prātimokṣa restraint of the seven assemblies (Xuanzang 七眾所受, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:4.16: *kaṭhina*: unidentified; Xuanzang transliterates 羯恥那家 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:5.7: Shukla supplies *[a]dharmatayā*; read *dharmatayā* (Xuanzang 以法呵責, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:5.8: Printed *vi[śi]ṣṭebhyo*, letters lost (Shukla p. 41 n. 2); read *aniṣṭebhyo* (Xuanzang 非愛, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:5.9: Printed *saṁdhibhyo*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 故犯 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:5.14: Printed *divasaṁ śikṣāpadaśataṁ*, corrupt; Xuanzang 過於二百五十學處 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:5.16: Printed *yeṣu punaḥ … kuśalo bhavati*; read *akuśalo* (Xuanzang 若諸學處未得善巧, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:10.3: Printed *saukṛtyakaraṇīyeṣu*; read *akaukṛtyakaraṇīyeṣu* (Xuanzang 不應作諸惡作, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:10.4: Printed *ākhyātaṁ*; read *āghātaṁ* (Xuanzang 惱害心, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:11.11: Printed *durmoṣo durgharajātīyaḥ*; read *duṣpoṣo durbharajātīyaḥ* (Xuanzang 難養難滿, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:11.27: Printed *cānyataraś*; read *cāḍhyataraś* (Xuanzang 財寶豐饒, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:11.61: Printed *śīlābhyasanam*; read *śīlavyasanam* (Xuanzang 尸羅艱難, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:12.7: Printed *taddānaṁ*; read *tad ānanda* (Xuanzang 阿難, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:16.9: Printed *rāgodayaṁ rāgavipākaṁ*; read *duḥkhodayaṁ duḥkhavipākaṁ* (Xuanzang 能生眾苦，招苦異熟, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:16.14: Printed *atītam adhvānam upādāya … kṛtaṁ bhavati*, as at 16.20; this case ends in withholding or proceeding (16.18–19) and concerns a present action (Xuanzang 欲正造, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:16.17: Printed text anticipates 16.18 *savijñānāṁ sabrahmacāriṇām antike* (so 16.23 for 16.24); rendered once.
sbh1.3:18.17: Printed *sūktaṁ ta[…]*, the leaf torn (Shukla p. 60); Xuanzang 我已善作身語意行 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:18.19: Printed *bhīrūprāṇānāṁ*; read *bhīrutrāṇānāṁ* (Xuanzang 能救濟諸怖畏, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:20.1: Printed *pratiyujyate*; read *pratibudhyate* (Xuanzang 覺安, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:22.1: Printed *pra--trāṇāṁ*, unread; Xuanzang 惡友 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:23.1: Printed *pūrvabahvāsthānānāṁ*, corrupt; Xuanzang 魍魎、藥叉、宅神、非人 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:25.2: Printed *samadānāṁ atyarthajātaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 由戒淨故，即隨所願當得往生 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:25.5: Printed with dots before and after *vimokṣā*, the MS illegible (Shukla p. 62 n. 2); Xuanzang 寂靜勝解，超過色定，入無色定具足安住 (T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:32.17: *niryāṇakāritā* (32.16, 32.18) is partly illegible in the MS (Shukla p. 65 n. 1) and doubtful; Xuanzang 委細所作 ‘careful action’ (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:32.30: Printed *sa bhā tā m eva*, corrupt; read *sa tām eva* [*smṛtim*] (Xuanzang 如是念增上力, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:34.6: Printed *rūpeṣu* for *dharmeṣu* (so 34.9), and *aparā jātir nimittaṁ*, with no counterpart in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 23): the heading of 34.17 (復有餘類), not rendered here.
sbh1.3:34.26: Printed *anusravanti*; read *nānusravanti* (Xuanzang 不生 … 令心流漏, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:34.32: Printed *mohasamutthāpitaṁ*; Xuanzang 二所起, hatred and delusion (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:35.2: Printed *utpannānadhivāsayati*; read *utpannān nādhivāsayati* (42.107; Xuanzang 不執著, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:35.17: Printed text omits *yac ca saṁvṛṇoti* (35.21; Xuanzang 所防護, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:35.20: Printed *ārakṣitā ca smṛtiḥ*; Xuanzang adds alert mindfulness (常委正念, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:36.3: Printed text omits *na madārthaṁ* (39.61; Xuanzang 不為憍逸, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:37.10: Printed *chanditakopamaḥ*; read *charditakopamaḥ* (Xuanzang 變吐, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:37.19: Printed *arthataś*; read *ardhataś* (Xuanzang 一分, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:37.44: Printed *saṁgo vā mā māpadyate … moho … ’tiphala*; read *saṁmoham āpadyate … mogho … ’phala* (Xuanzang 迷悶…唐捐無果, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.16: Printed *akālañ ca*; read *kālañ ca* (Xuanzang 既捨命已, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.29: Printed *na na te asaṁtuṣṭā*; read *na te susaṁtuṣṭāḥ* (Xuanzang 非妙喜足, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.31: Printed *tan me pratimaṁ syād*; read *tan na me pratirūpaṁ syād* (39.32; Xuanzang 非我宜, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.32: Printed *putramāṁ (mān)*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 如子肉想 (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.35: Printed *paribhūtam* (39.34), corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 如法而自安處 (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.57: Printed *sārddhaṁmalābu-romaśabāhubhiḥ*, unread; Xuanzang has only 姝妙嚴飾女人 ‘beautifully adorned women’ (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.58: Printed *anuddhatendriyaś ca*, a repetition of *uddhatendriyo*; not rendered (Xuanzang has four members, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.65: Printed *endhābhūte*, which Shukla reads *aindhībhūte*, unread; Xuanzang has only 過今夜分 (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.66: Printed *atartkāyā*, corrected by Shukla to *ātatīkriyayā* (p. 86 n. 2: Tibetan ‘stretching the bow’; Xuanzang 控弦); *vyāyāmaśilā* ‘exercise-stone’ (托石) (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.90: Printed *asaṁniveṣaṇā-*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 所不應習 (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.106: Printed *nābhyadhiko*; read *nābādhiko* (39.10; Xuanzang 無有困苦, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:39.109: Printed *surakto*; read *sa ’rakto*; printed text omits *amūrchitaḥ* (39.100; Xuanzang 迷悶, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:40.16: Printed *varṇaṁ* (also 40.20); read *balaṁ* (40.49; Xuanzang 力, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:40.39: Printed text omits the question (so 40.41, 40.44, 40.50); supplied from Xuanzang 云何為攝受對治 (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:40.62: Printed *nāpariṇatena saṁkliṣṭaṁ*; read *nāpariṇate na saṁkliṣṭaṁ* (40.65; Xuanzang 非不消食、非染污食, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:40.69: Printed *(na) [sama]viṣamabhojanena*; read *samabhojanena* (40.70, 40.73; Xuanzang 由平等食非極多食, T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:40.100: Printed text has one answer; Xuanzang has first ‘for the stilling of hunger — by this he rejects eating too little’ (為除飢渴，由此遮止所食極少, T1579 juan 23); Shukla's *(punar atiprabhūtabhojanaṁ)* in the question is not rendered.
sbh1.3:40.106: Printed *atyalpabhojanatāṁ pra(tāmapra)bhūtabhojanatāṁ ca darśayati (pratikṣipati)*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 顯示不極少食、不極多食 (T1579 juan 23).
sbh1.3:42.9: Printed text omits the first-watch clause, quoted at 42.117 and 42.198 (Xuanzang 於初夜分經行、宴坐，從順障法淨修其心, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.17: Printed *sthāna*; read *sthāma* (Xuanzang 勢力, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.19: Printed *sāvadyaḥ*, corrupt; read *sātatyam* (Xuanzang 無間相續, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.31: Printed *[a]śubhatā*, the *a* supplied by Shukla; read *śubhatā* (Xuanzang 淨妙相, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.50: Printed *catur-*; read *candra-* (Xuanzang 星月, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.54: Printed *vibhadrātmakaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 變壞 (T1579 juan 24; sbh2.2:4.2).
sbh1.3:42.64: Printed *asaṁpathena*, *smāritvā* (also 42.65); read *asapatnena*, *spharitvā* (Xuanzang 無敵, 普遍, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.107: Printed *pratirūpatāṁ*; read *apratirūpatāṁ* (Xuanzang 非善法, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.122: Printed *-nai[ka]pakṣye*, the *ka* Shukla's for a damaged letter; Xuanzang 無間常委 ‘uninterrupted and earnest’ (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.159: Printed *viddhamavakramaṇa-*; read *middhāvakramaṇa-* (Xuanzang 睡眠, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.167: Printed *gāḍhaṁ svapiti*; read *na gāḍhaṁ* (42.223; Xuanzang 無重睡眠, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:42.188: Printed *-nai[ka]pakṣya-* (also 42.200), the *ka* Shukla's for a damaged letter; Xuanzang 無間常委 ‘uninterrupted and earnest’ (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:43.4: Printed text omits *gate sthite*, which 47.6 and Xuanzang 若行、若住 (T1579 juan 24) have; printed *pra[la]pite*, read *bhāṣite* (47.6).
sbh1.3:44.19: Printed *mārutānām*, corrupt; Xuanzang has four terms, 房舍、屋宇、殿堂、廊廟, for the five (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:45.8: Printed text repeats 45.7 (*ādhiṣṭhānikaṁ vā cīvaraṁ atirekacīvaraṁ vā*), running into 45.9.
sbh1.3:45.12: Printed *bhaikṣabhojanam*; read *bhaikṣabhājanam* (Xuanzang 乞食應器, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:47.66: Printed text has a gap after *iyam asyocyate*, which Shukla fills with *[nidrāklamaprativinodanā]* (Sh. p. 121 n. 1); Xuanzang has the formulaic close 如是名為於行…於解勞睡正知而住 (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:48.1: Printed *stutibhāvanā*; read *prabhāvanā* (Xuanzang 為顯何事, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:48.14: Printed *sthena*; read *rathena* (Xuanzang 眾車, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:48.21: Printed *mā vā dadatu*; read *mā vā na dadatu* (Xuanzang 非不惠施, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:48.32: Printed *āvaraṇajātaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 遊戲 (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:48.45: Printed *kā[ra]yitavyaṁ*, damaged; the sense follows Xuanzang 持鉢在飲食上 (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:48.48: Printed *tittinikāyogam anuyuktena*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 饕餮 (T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:49.2: Printed *parakṣye (parokṣe)*; read *parapakṣye* (49.4; Xuanzang 非於他處, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:49.3: Printed *-enāmanasikārānugatena* (*amanasikāra*); read *manasikārānugatena* (Xuanzang 為善思惟, T1579 juan 24).
sbh1.3:52.2: The MS breaks off here and resumes within the second quality of the good friend (Sh. p. 127 nn. 1–2); the lost close of full awareness, the heading of association with good friends and its eight qualities survive in Xuanzang (T1579 juan 24, 0416b25–0417a17; juan 25, 0417a27–b07).
sbh1.3:52.10: Printed *dviviṣayasya*; read *ṛddhiviṣayasya* (Xuanzang 神境通, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:52.28: Printed *vādito na prativādayati*; read *tāḍito na pratitāḍayati* (Xuanzang 打不報打, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:52.29: Printed *maṇḍito na pratimaṇḍayati*; read *bhaṇḍito na pratibhaṇḍayati* (Xuanzang 弄不報弄, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:52.30: Printed *anena dānapratyādānasamo bhavati*, Shukla's reading of a dim passage (Sh. p. 130 n. 1); the sense follows Xuanzang 堪耐椎杵 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:52.36: Printed *patanapakṣāṇāṁ*; read *vacanapathānāṁ* (80.39; Xuanzang 語言, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:53.5: Printed *kampābhyāṁ*; read *kakṣābhyāṁ* (Xuanzang 腋, T1579 juan 25). Printed *rogaklamebhyo vā*, corrupt; Xuanzang has 身毛不竪.
sbh1.3:54.9: Printed *smarati*; read *na smarati* (Xuanzang 不能憶, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:54.41: Printed *bhāvyācārān adhyācārān*, letter indistinct (Sh. p. 133 n. 2), corrupt; Xuanzang has 為令現行不現行 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:54.46: Printed *phalaṁ vā*; read *mārgaṁ vā* (Xuanzang 道論, T1579 juan 25). Printed *saparipākāya (sattvasaṁkleśāya ?) vā*, corrupt; Xuanzang has maturation and purification only (成熟 … 清淨).
sbh1.3:54.49: Printed *cātmānam utkarṣayati*; read *nātmānam* (Xuanzang 不自高舉, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:56.9: Printed *dhātusaṁgaṇasaṁyuktā vā* repeats *dhātupratisaṁyuktā vā*, not rendered; Xuanzang has one 界相應語 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:56.14: Printed *buddhacaryopasaṁhitānāṁ*; read *brahmacaryopasaṁhitānāṁ* (54.25; Xuanzang 梵行, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:61.2: Printed text omits *śrāmaṇera* and *upāsaka* (Xuanzang 勞策男 … 近事男, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:62.40: Printed *cetanāskandhaḥ*; read *saṁskāraskandhaḥ* (Xuanzang 行蘊, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:63.25: Printed text omits *anātmatā* (63.23; Xuanzang 及無我性, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:64.8: Printed *kṛtapuṇyo … saukṛtatvāt … lābhī* (64.8–9); read *akṛtapuṇyo … na lābhī* (Xuanzang 不曾修福 … 不能獲得, T1579 juan 25; cf. 65.9).
sbh1.3:64.20: Printed text omits *saṁsargārāma* and *prapañcārāma* (65.24, 65.26; Xuanzang 樂相雜住、樂著戲論, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:65.19: Printed *vastukathāṁ*; read *vastrakathāṁ* (Xuanzang 衣服, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:65.35: Printed *pra[bhinnaḥ]* (pin-hole); read *pramādaḥ* (65.80; Xuanzang 放逸, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:65.55: Printed *ratijñā*; read *rātrijñā* (Xuanzang 耆年, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:65.58: Printed *vivṛtāni ca sthānāni vivṛṇvanti*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 顯了未顯了處 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:65.74: Printed *subhāṣitabhāṣī*; read *durbhāṣitabhāṣī* (Xuanzang 惡說所說, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:66.3: Printed *ko dadāti [kasmai dadāti kutra dadāti] kena ca dadāti*, the bracketed pair by a later hand; *kiṁ dadāti* supplied from 69.1 (Xuanzang 用何施, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:67.2: Printed text has no definition of *dātā* before *ayam ucyate dātā*; Xuanzang has 若自手施，名為施者 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:69.8: Printed *puruṣasaṁkhyātaṁ*; read *sattvasaṁkhyātaṁ* (Xuanzang 有情數物, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:69.15: Printed *tena vyāpāditā*; read *na tena vyāpāditā* (Xuanzang 不為損惱, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:71.4: Printed text has *yac ca sattvasaṁkhyātaṁ vastu* only; Xuanzang names both, 有情數物、無情數物 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:72.4: Printed *de[śa]vastu* (*śa* by a later hand); read *deyavastu* (Xuanzang 所施物, T1579 juan 25). Printed text has *svasaṁtāne vā* alone; Xuanzang has 或自相續，或他相續.
sbh1.3:72.19: Printed *datvā vā vipratisārī*; read *datvā na vipratisārī* (Xuanzang 施已無悔, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:74.4: Printed *vimuktibahulaḥ*; read *adhimuktibahulaḥ* (Xuanzang 勝解, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:74.16: Printed *rujako bhavati rujakajātīyaḥ*; read *ṛjuko bhavati ṛjukajātīyaḥ* (Xuanzang 正直, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:74.26: Printed *nikṣiptadhuraḥ*; read *anikṣiptadhuraḥ* (Xuanzang 不捨軛, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:74.39: Printed *sa labdhvā*; read *so 'labdhvā* (Xuanzang 所未得, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:74.63: *veśyānuveśyakulāni*: house to house (Xuanzang 巡家而乞, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:79.12: Printed *tūlāvahade*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 氈褥 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:79.14: Printed text lacks the robe clause after *cīvararāgeṇa* (letters damaged at a pin-hole, Shukla p. 161 n. 1); Xuanzang has it, 於諸衣服令心染著 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.1: Printed *prahīṇa*; read *praṇīta* (80.3). The five pairings are as printed; Xuanzang (T1579 juan 25) has: fine food, alms-food taker and sequential alms-food taker; plentiful food, one-seat eater and later-food refuser; many robes, three-robe wearer; soft touch, felt-wearer; fine robes, refuse-rag wearer.
sbh1.3:80.7: Printed *saṁsparśa-*; read *saṁsarga-* (80.11; Xuanzang 諠雜, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.14: Printed *middhena rāgasya*; read *maithunarāgasya* (Xuanzang 婬佚貪, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.20: Printed *vyarthaṁ pracārayati*, corrupt; read *pravārayanti* (Xuanzang 極恣, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.24: Printed *bahuśrutopakaraṇenopetaḥ*; read *bahuśruto vākkaraṇenopetaḥ* (53.10; Xuanzang 語具圓滿, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.25: Printed *utkarṣayati … paṁsayati* without negation; read *na … na* (Xuanzang 不自高舉，不陵蔑他, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.36: Printed *vādito na prativādayati*; read *tāḍito na pratitāḍayati* (Xuanzang 打不報打, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.44: Printed *aparibhogī ca*, doubtful; Xuanzang has only the sharing in common, 和同受用 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.48: Printed *sthavādakaraṇaiḥ*; read *avivādakaraṇaiḥ* (Xuanzang 無違諍, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.68: Printed *kātheyaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 詩論 (T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.71: Printed *tena cātmadaṁ vā nyī(cī)varaṁ dhārayati*, damaged and corrupt (Shukla p. 164 nn. 1–2); the sense follows Xuanzang 不樂貯畜餘長衣鉢 (T1579 juan 25; cf. 75.11).
sbh1.3:80.78: Printed *sāme*; read *mā me* (80.81; Xuanzang 勿我, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.82: Printed *śraddhodayaṁ*; read *śraddhādeyaṁ* (80.84; Xuanzang 信施, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.89: Printed *saṁvidya(te)*; read *saṁcintya* (Xuanzang 故思, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.95: Printed *janakāḥ*; read *jānakāḥ* (Xuanzang 所知, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.96: Printed *duḥpratiniḥsargamaṁntrī*; read *duṣpratiniḥsargī* (Xuanzang has 言論呪術 here, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.97: Printed *manana-*; read *maṇḍana-* (Xuanzang 好自莊嚴, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.98: Printed *avavādavastuprāvṛtaḥ*; read *avadātavastraprāvṛtaḥ* (Xuanzang 服鮮白衣, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:80.100: Printed *harṣair*; read *hārair* (Xuanzang 瓔珞, T1579 juan 25).
sbh1.3:83.1: Printed *caiva tathā śravaṇacintanā* is defective; *kalyāṇamitratā* is missing (Xuanzang 善友, T1579 juan 22).
sbh1.3:85.1: Printed *dhutaprāṇādikamātratā kṣāntiḥ saurabhyapeśalā*, corrupt and short; Xuanzang's uddāna has the dharmas of good persons and the marks of the wise before patience (T1579 juan 25).
